info.name: HRMS-B — Branches
info.description: Branch module API. All routes scoped under /api/companies/:company_id/branches. Includes geofence endpoint for attendance check-in/out.

  "branch_name": "Dubai HQ",

  "is_head_office": true,
  "country": "UAE",
  "state": "Dubai",
  "city": "Dubai",
  "address": "Office 501, Business Bay Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road",
  "phone": "+97141234567",
  "email": "dubai@acme.com",
  "latitude": 25.18540000,
  "longitude": 55.26950000,
  "attendance_radius": 100
}

request.description: Admin only. Creates a branch under the company. latitude + longitude are required for geofence-based attendance check-in/out. attendance_radius is in meters (default 100m).

request.description: Admin only. Disables the branch. Employees assigned to this branch can no longer check in via geofence.
Admin only. Soft deletes a branch. Users linked via user_companies.branch_id will have branch_id set to NULL automatically (ON DELETE SET NULL in DB).
